80067.subject: Useful is optional
80067.body:
View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/eaa70932-7ce4-467e-b338-a662ed575d6a/0xR_NL_Banner_Heading_Wordmark.jpg?t=1776775276)
Caption: 

GM. Two things from us today: a PoW chain whose own supporters concede its miners aren't currently doing useful work, and a launch from our side of the house.

On our end, we launched the Blockworks MCP today. It runs on the [Unified API](https://blockworks.com/insights/introducing-the-blockworks-unified-api) we released last week, which puts all of the Blockworks and Messari data behind a single API key: more than 40K assets across 300+ exchanges, standardized financials for 400+ DeFi protocols, plus research, news, fundraising, unlocks and issuer disclosures. Add Blockworks as an app in ChatGPT, or paste one URL into Claude, Cursor or any MCP client. Ask questions in plain English, get numbers back with sources attached, chart them in your own branding. 

Separately, [Nockscan](https://nockscan.com/) posted a stat over the weekend that clashes with both sides of the PRL vs NOCK debate. [Nockchain](https://nockchain.org/) miners, running an AI-PoW mode that exists to merge-mine Pearl, [produced](https://x.com/nocktoshi/status/2102161354983440548) 55% Pearl blocks between September 14-21st. 

[Pearl](https://x.com/prlnet) launched in April as a Bitcoin fork with matrix multiplication swapped in to replace standard SHA-256. The pitch from [Pearl Research Labs](https://pearlresearch.ai/) is that a GPU serving an LLM can mine PRL as a secondary revenue stream at ~5% overhead. Five months in, the [chain](https://pool.kryptex.com/prl/about-coin) sits at ~50 EH/s, PRL trades around $1.24, up 2.5% on the week, and Entropy [paid](https://x.com/HyperliquidNews/status/2103755942378504563) 555 HYPE for the PRL ticker on Hyperliquid on Friday. Both camps agree on the facts, which is the odd part. In June, a [preprint](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.04819) measured the [network](https://2miners.com/prl-network-hashrate) at 24 EH/s, and found zero strings referencing vLLM, Llama or any inference framework in the dominant miner binary, confirmed that the protocol accepts random matrices by design, and earned 44 pool-accepted shares with no model loaded. 

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/150fcec7-f626-4c72-9b9e-98c00ec2b34a/image.png?t=1790859087)
Caption: 

[Brian Breslow](https://x.com/brezshares) of No Limit Holdings [published](https://x.com/brezshares/status/2098035744598319569) a thesis that calls Pearl the next Bitcoin, and his answer to the paper is that it describes the design. Pearl only verifies expensive matrix multiplication. A miner who feeds it garbage pays full GPU cost for PRL. Miners who feed it customer inference have a customer paying the power bill and absorbing the overhead alone. Raise difficulty enough and the garba

Щоб і надалі користуватися цими службами iCloud, потрібно оновити план до iCloud+: https://setup.icloud.com/email/prefs/storage?path=STORAGE_AND_BACKUP/CHANGE_STORAGE_PLAN або звільнити місце в сховищі.
